title: The Five Senses
seo_title: Year 1 Science: The Five Senses Worksheets (Sight, Hearing, Smell, Taste, Touch)
standard_text: Identify, name, draw and label the basic parts of the human body and say which part of the body is associated with each sense.
meta_desc: Free Year 1 science worksheets on the five senses: sight, hearing, smell, taste and touch, the body part for each sense, sense words, staying safe and a sound walk. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Eyes see, ears hear, nose smells, tongue tastes, skin feels.
body_html:
How to think about it

We have five senses.

  • Sight (eyes), hearing (ears), smell (nose).
  • Taste (tongue) and touch (skin).
  • Our senses help keep us safe.
Example

Which sense tells you a drum is loud?

Ears

Answer: hearing

Example

We taste with?

Inside the mouth

Answer: our tongue

Common mistakes

  • Thinking we taste with our nose.
  • Thinking touch only happens with our hands.
  • Thinking smell and taste are the same.

faq.a: Sight, hearing, smell, taste and touch.

faq.q: Which body part goes with each sense?
faq.a: We see with our eyes, hear with our ears, smell with our nose, taste with our tongue and feel with our skin.

faq.q: How do our senses keep us safe?
faq.a: We can smell smoke, hear a fire alarm or a car, see a red light, taste milk that has gone off and feel if something is too hot.
